title: Summoner combo, staves and swords fixed
changes: The Summoner has its own 3-hit staff combo: two quick bolts, then an elemental burst in your attuned element.
Fixed: Wizards fought with the Summoner's staff numbers (less damage, slower). Wizard staves hit as before again.
Fixed: Knights fought with the Vampire's sword numbers. Each class now uses its own weapon numbers.
